name: How can I tell if my kitchen sink drain is starting to clog?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my kitchen sink drain is starting to clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early signs of a kitchen sink clog include slow draining, gurgling sounds from the drain, or unpleasant odors emanating from the sink. If you notice water backing up even slightly after running the faucet, it's a strong indicator of a developing blockage. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent a complete clog and potentially more extensive issues, often allowing for simpler, quicker intervention by a professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for slow draining, gurgling noises, or odors. Water backing up slightly is also a key indicator of an impending clog.
